claims.text: The experiment was evaluated using the hits@k metric, which measures the average number of times the correct selection appears in the top k predictions.
Two scenarios were considered for evaluation: predicting the next clicked hotel among all hotels and predicting among hotels within the same market.
Cosine similarity of embedding vectors was also used to measure hits@k, showing that it can be effective even without using the model's output probabilities.
